chapter: Gangsters, records, women musicians and the blues
title: Cheated by Mayo Williams but now paid foreign royalties
summary: She got a few hundred dollars for the biggest record ever, but now receives "Downhearted Blues" royalties from Scandinavia and welcomes new law letting authors recall contracts.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: But you must be getting money now on 'Downhearted Blues'.
Oh, do you know what I got the other day?
No.
I hope I brought it. I got money from Finland --
Oh, yes.
-- from Denmark, from Finland. I have
it here. I'll show it to you.
Uh-huh.
Royalties on 'Downhearted Blues'. Now, what are you going to do about that? Isn't that wonderful?
Yes.

I'm still getting money. But the contract, just think, I got a fourth of a penny. I was supposed to get a fourth of a penny on the record and I didn't get that. Isn't that unkind? You know, fate's a -- but I'm living to tell it. That's the part I'm proud of.
Right.
God is so good. He's good. I'm living to tell how I was cheated, and still getting contracts sent to me to sign away my rights, my rights and all.
Yes.
But ASCAP and AGAC have done some wonderful things. They fixed it so you not only get your 75 years, but you get life.
Right.
And some of the contracts that we have signed, we can recall them and resign them in our way. God is so good. Yes.
It's about time, I guess.
About time. And I'm living to tell it. I'm living to tell it. That's right, I'm living to tell it.

My grandmother always told me, keep God in front of you. You'll make it. Uh-huh. I'm living to tell it. Send me contracts now to sign, and they take your material, you have your material with a certain publisher, and he'll take all your material and turn it over to somebody else without your signing the fact that you want your stuff to go to that particular person or particular organization or company. Take advantage of you. All right. That's all right. I'm living to tell it.
That's good.
Yes. And maybe that'll help somebody else that don't know what they're doing.
